conventions.append_only: 旧定义不被覆写；新量名与旧别名并列登记
conventions.direction: ox = maximize; reduction_resistance_score Sred = -EA = maximize; raw EA = minimize
conventions.missing_rule: 缺值/不合格态记为 None，绝不替换成 0
conventions.state_identity: 还原轴主 ranking 只允许 molecule_centered_redox
conventions.gate1_status: Gate 1 NOT CLOSED / NOT CLOSABLE（本批次不改动）

quantities.name: Eox_vertical
quantities.definition: E(M+) - E(M) on the same initial geometry

quantities.name: Eox_adiabatic
quantities.definition: electronic-energy difference between the two relaxed states

quantities.name: Gox_single
quantities.definition: free-energy difference from one representative minimum per state
quantities.thermal_policy: qRRHO thermal correction on solution frequencies

quantities.name: Gox_ensemble
quantities.definition: conformer-ensemble free-energy difference, -RT ln sum g_i exp(-G_i/RT)
quantities.thermal_policy: qRRHO thermal correction on solution frequencies
quantities.ensemble_policy: conformer ensemble within a frozen energy window

quantities.name: Gox_Li_ensemble
quantities.thermal_policy: qRRHO thermal correction on solution frequencies
quantities.ensemble_policy: conformer/motif ensemble within a frozen energy window

quantities.name: coordination_shift
quantities.geometry_policy: difference of two independently relaxed conditional species

quantities.name: Sred
quantities.thermal_policy: qRRHO thermal correction on solution frequencies
quantities.ensemble_policy: conformer ensemble within a frozen energy window

claim_migration.question: Q3
claim_migration.historical: C1 全态负 tau 被当作分子还原排序脆弱性的证据
claim_migration.new_statement: C1 全态负 tau 不再用于分子还原排序脆弱性的确认性判断；还原排序在 C1 条件下因身份分层而无定义（n=1）。
claim_migration.risk_if_unmigrated: 把身份混合当成物理脆弱性，得出不可认证的还原排序结论。

claim_migration.question: Q7
claim_migration.historical: 构象敏感性与 method 主导的 tolerance 被合并解释
claim_migration.new_statement: 构象敏感性（p90）与 method 主导的 tolerance 分开解释、分开计数；二者不同量纲，不得互相标定。
claim_migration.risk_if_unmigrated: 用构象 p90 冒充方法误差，或用方法 sigma 抹掉构象不确定性。

claim_migration.question: Q10
claim_migration.historical: Gate 1 措辞可被读成世界范围不存在合格数据
claim_migration.new_statement: 统一为：在既定检索标准下未定位到合格数据，不能断言世界范围不存在；NOT CLOSABLE != NO SUCH DATA EXIST ANYWHERE。
claim_migration.risk_if_unmigrated: 把检索失败的负结果读成普适的不可能性断言。

claim_migration.question: R15
claim_migration.historical: R15 的代数恒等式被读成独立物理机制验证
claim_migration.new_statement: 区分定义性零翻转（代数恒等式）与经验未观测；计算成本最多与改排序相关，不声称因果定律。
claim_migration.risk_if_unmigrated: 把判据分析当成物理定律，夸大结论强度。

claim_migration.question: P1a
claim_migration.historical: P1a 的电子能差被 thermodynamics 标签掩盖缺失热校正
claim_migration.source: config/scientific_definitions.yaml#P1a; 计划.md 第 2 节
claim_migration.new_statement: 写明 P1a 处在电子能层；不以其 thermodynamics 措辞掩盖缺失的热校正，新批次显式区分 E / E+ZPE / G_single / G_ensemble。
claim_migration.risk_if_unmigrated: 用热力学术语包装纯电子能差，误导可比性与精度预期。
